description: Manage operator groups: add or remove members, link or unlink channels, assign supervisors, and control visibility of other operators' conversations. Take group names from list_workspace_metadata(resource='groups'). Requires confirm: true.

action.description: Action: add_member (add operator), remove_member (remove operator), add_channel (bind channel), remove_channel (unlink channel), set_supervisor (assign/remove supervisor), set_channel_visibility (dialog visibility).

can_view_other_dialogs.description: For set_channel_visibility: true - allow viewing of other people's conversations in the channel, false - prohibit.

channel.description: Channel name or ID (for add_channel, remove_channel, set_channel_visibility).

confirm.description: Explicit confirmation of a group configuration change.

group.description: Operator group name or ID (get it via list_workspace_metadata with resource='groups').

is_supervisor.description: For set_supervisor, true grants supervisor access and false removes it.

operator.description: Operator name or ID (for add_member, remove_member, set_supervisor).

name: manage_operator_group
title: Manage operator group
